title: raw_vault.py: per-ym rewrite of _chunked_flightlist_vault (watermark-driven, partitioned writes, resume-safe)
objective: Rewrite etl4/vault/raw_vault.py::_chunked_flightlist_vault to loop per-month: skip bronze files whose ym <= watermark.get('vault','hub_flight'), build per-month frames, write via vault_io.write_partition under ym=YYYY-MM/part.parquet, compact the three non-partitioned small hubs into their monoliths atomically, and advance pipeline_watermarks in the same psycopg transaction as the per-ym layer write. Drop the DuckDB cross-file dedup pass -- each bronze file is now one month, so no cross-file dedup is needed.
unblocks: T-12 (migrate_partition_ym.py -- can now skip hub_flight/link_*/sat_flight_summary trees that are already partition-shaped)
T-14 (marts.py partition-aware reads -- needs vault partitions to exist)
T-22 (run_e2e pre-flight list_ym drift check -- needs real watermark rows)

files_changed.note: -157/+225 net +68. Removed: duckdb import, _duckdb_dedup_shards() helper (37 lines), _shards/ accumulator path (90 lines), DuckDB tmp cleanup. Added: psycopg + pyarrow + vault_io + watermark imports; PARTITIONED_TABLES / NON_PARTITIONED_TABLES constants; _atomic_write_monolith (tmp + os.replace for small hubs); _states_extras_frame; _compact_small_hub (T-09 stub with '# T-09 will replace this' marker); _partition_done / _write_done sentinel helpers; rewritten _chunked_flightlist_vault with watermark-driven per-ym loop.

contract_deviations: Task brief's literal smoke command `python -m etl4.vault.raw_vault --flightlist-dir data/bronze/synthetic --out data/silver/vault --no-states` cannot work: data/bronze/synthetic holds state-vector data (date=/hour=/ layout, no callsign/day columns) and its paths do not match ym_from_filename's `flightlist_YYYYMMDD_YYYYMMDD.parquet` regex, so every file is skipped. Smoke replaces the fixture with head(5000) of two real monthly Zenodo flightlists under a scratch dir carrying the canonical filename. Non-blocking -- T-09/T-14 do not depend on the exact smoke command.

Task says 'Watermark advance in SAME psycopg txn as the final per-ym commit' and references hub_flight only; implementation writes watermark rows for all 4 partitioned flightlist tables (hub_flight, link_flight_aircraft, link_flight_route, sat_flight_summary) in the same txn. Rationale: architecture section 3 says every partitioned table gets its own watermark row; migration seed (section 6 seed_watermarks) emits one row per table; rewind (section 7) reads per-table watermarks. Using only hub_flight would stale-skew the other three. The read gate still keys on 'hub_flight' alone as the task specifies.

Architecture Risk R13 ('raw_vault.py loads every bronze icao24 regardless of watermark') is NOT addressed in this task -- the states_hub_input read remains unfiltered. Flagged as follow-up; Postgres-side cost is bounded by icao24 cardinality (~10^5), so it is a minor deferment.
spec_gaps_resolved: Spec silent on 'how does the small-hub compaction interact with watermark advance'. Implemented: compact FIRST, then watermark set + commit, inside the same per-ym iteration. If the compaction crashes, the watermark has not moved, so the next run will re-fold the month's small-hub frames idempotently. This is the correctness gap the advisor flagged.

Spec says 'drop the DuckDB cross-file dedup pass'. Implemented by removing (a) the duckdb import, (b) _duckdb_dedup_shards helper, (c) the _shards/ accumulator directory logic, (d) the _duckdb_tmp cleanup. Each bronze file still runs the per-file drop_duplicates inside the build_* helpers.

Spec silent on 'ym column in file body or in path only'. Implemented by setting frame['ym'] = pd.Series([ym]*len, dtype='string') before write_partition. Matches architecture finding #4 and T-12 migration output (which stores ym both in path and in file body). Smoke CASE asserts ym is in the file body after round-trip.
